entities.name: Pedro Pablo Bermúdez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pedro Pablo Bermúdez Ascarza was a Peruvian politician and a member of the Peruvian military. He briefly served as the Provisional Supreme Ruler of Peru between 4 January and 24 April 1834, having previously served as Minister of War from 1832 to 1833.

entities.summary: Pedro Pablo Bermúdez Ascarza was a Peruvian politician and a member of the Peruvian military. He briefly served as the Provisional Supreme Ruler of Peru between 4 January and 24 April 1834, having previously served as Minister of War from 1832 to 1833.
